<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
greens = [(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in nodes if n['color']=='N']
print(f'{len(greens)} greens at (top-left):', greens)
# Collect them all
for (r,c) in greens:
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r+1,'col':c+1}])
    ng = sum(1 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    if res.get('done'):
        print(f'COLLECTED ({r+1},{c+1}): done! ngreens={ng}')
        break
    if ng == 0:
        print(f'COLLECTED ({r+1},{c+1}): all greens cleared! ngreens=0')
        break
else:
    print('all collected, not done')
    ng = sum(1 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    print(f'final ngreens={ng}')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
